title: Lattice Model Section for Stabilizers
body_html:
Lattice Model Section for Stabilizers

For a self-dual lattice \(A\) in the symplectic space \(W\), the lattice model of the oscillator representation defines a section \[ \omega_A:\operatorname{Sp}_A(W)\to \operatorname{Mp}(W). \] If \(A\) is chosen between \(B_{0+}\) and \(B_0\) for the tensor-product lattice function attached to \(x\), then the section gives the splitting used on the compact subgroups \(G_x\) and \(G_{x,0+}\).
proof_html: Appendix 3 proves the key independence statement: sections from two self-dual lattices agree on the intersection of their stabilizers. The intertwining operator between the two lattice models is unique up to scalar; conjugating by an element stabilizing both lattices commutes with that operator, forcing equality of the two sections.
